next_experiments.hypothesis: Track 01 of each #462-locked Saturn Bomberman CUE contains a valid Sega Saturn IP.BIN system header and ISO-9660 file hierarchy accounting for boot SH-2 code, BOMSS*.CPK Cinepak streams, sound driver/banks, and packed graphics/map containers, while remaining tracks are Red Book CD-DA.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Verified #462 USA and Japan input-lock manifests on read-only staged media (zero modification of /home/dev/Sega-Saturn-BIOS).
next_experiments.changed_variable: Compare USA vs Japan disc header, ISO-9660 directory entries, sector ranges, and SHA-256 digests against #463 BOMSS1..3.CPK and M_*.AIF leads.
expected_observations: 100% byte/sector range accounting of Track 01 and all CUE-referenced BIN tracks for USA and Japan.
Exact regional product serials, revision strings, and binary file/archive inventory with unknown compression formats isolated for decoder work.
failure_conditions: Any sector or byte range on Track 01 is silently skipped instead of classified.
File extensions are reported as decoded formats without magic/structure validation.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Bounded VDP1 command/texture/CLUT and VDP2 tile/palette capture on pinned Beetle Saturn recovers raw indexed sprites, palettes, anchors, and frame durations for White Bomberman, Normal Stage 1-1, and Standard Battle Arena without altering canonical replay hashes.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Pinned #27 USA checkpoint in fresh isolated process with fixed RTC, clean backup RAM, and deterministic input script.
next_experiments.changed_variable: Enable vs disable bounded VDP1/VDP2 read-only instrumentation across identical 3-process replays.
expected_observations: Identical canonical gameplay/video digests with and without VDP tracing enabled.
Recovered raw indexed textures, palettes, draw coordinates, and frame durations filling the three #463 gap tables.
failure_conditions: Instrumentation alters emulated timing or replay digests.
Reconstructed sample frame diverges from reference frame beyond documented renderer rules.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Controlled single-variable input sweeps from #27 checkpoints measure exact subpixel speed, corner assistance, and bomb fuse/chain frame counts, allowing compare_trace.py to pass on matching Neptune Saturn-profile scenarios and fail on a 1-frame fuse or subpixel mutation.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Pinned #27 battle arena checkpoint and equivalent Neptune scenario adapter.
next_experiments.changed_variable: 1-frame directional press/release, bomb placement, chain-reaction distance, and deliberate +/-1 tick fuse mutation.
expected_observations: Exact frame-by-frame trace agreement on canonical fixed-point observations and deterministic failure on deliberate mutation.
failure_conditions: Trace comparator passes on synthetic or mutated traces or masks unstable fields.
